# nvinfer primary GIE config — YOLOv10 TRT FP16
# DeepStream 8.0 / RTX 3050 (Ampere sm86)
#
# Engine is built on first run (~3-4 min) and cached. Subsequent starts load instantly.
# DS 8.0 auto-generates the engine filename from the ONNX name: yolov10.onnx_b10_gpu0_fp16.engine
# model-engine-file must match this auto-generated name or DS will rebuild every restart.

[property]
gpu-id=0
net-scale-factor=0.0039215697906911373

onnx-file=/Aksha/trt_cache/yolov10.onnx
model-engine-file=/Aksha/trt_cache/yolov10.onnx_b10_gpu0_fp16.engine

labelfile-path=/code/app/coco.names

# batch-size=10: each pod handles 10 cameras (MAX_CAMERAS=10 in docker-compose).
# TRT allocates workspace for the max batch — batch=10 uses ~300-500MB vs ~2GB for batch=40.
# Leaving enough VRAM for NVDEC decoder buffer pools (each camera ~100MB on RTX 3050).
# batched-push-timeout on nvstreammux fires inference even when batch is not full.
batch-size=10

# network-mode=2: FP16 — Tensor Cores on Ampere/Turing GPUs.
# Switch to 1 for FP32 only if detection quality degrades on a specific model.
network-mode=2

num-detected-classes=80

# interval=0: run inference on every frame reaching nvinfer.
# Frame rate is throttled upstream by nvurisrcbin drop-frame-interval.
interval=0

gie-unique-id=1

# output-tensor-meta=1: expose raw tensor output as NvDsInferTensorMeta user metadata.
# Required by _parse_tensors() in main.py to read YOLOv10 [N,300,6] output.
output-tensor-meta=1

process-mode=1
network-type=100

[class-attrs-all]
threshold=0.35
